limitations_and_boundaries: Model incorporated information from only two species: human and mouse.
Species-specific gene expression patterns may offset benefits of enlarged data size when including other species.
Other essential information such as enhancers and protein sequences should be explored.
Multimodal data (epigenomic, proteomic, metabolomic) not yet integrated.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.

research_questions.statement: Can a knowledge-informed cross-species foundation model (GeneCompass) decipher universal gene regulatory mechanisms and outperform existing models in downstream tasks?

provenance.text_excerpt: We also employed GeneCompass to search for key factors associated with cell fate transition and showed that the predicted candidate genes could successfully induce the differentiation of human embryonic stem cells into the gonadal fate.

claims.statement: GeneCompass can predict key regulatory factors for cell fate transitions, and predicted candidate genes (NR5A1, GATA4) successfully induce differentiation of human ESCs into gonadal fate.

provenance.text_excerpt: By fine-tuning for multiple downstream tasks, GeneCompass outperformed state-of-the-art models in diverse applications for a single species and unlocked new realms of cross-species biological investigations.

claims.statement: GeneCompass outperforms state-of-the-art models in diverse downstream tasks for a single species.

provenance.text_excerpt: These results showed that infusion of prior knowledge could promote the understanding of complex feature associations between biological data by the pre-trained foundation model.

claims.statement: Incorporating prior biological knowledge enhances pre-training performance of the foundation model.

evidence_spans.content: GeneCompass uses a deep learning architecture based on Transformer's self-attention mechanism to capture long-range dynamic associations between different genes in different cellular contexts.

provenance.text_excerpt: GeneCompass used a deep learning architecture based on Transformer’s self-attention mechanism to capture long-range dynamic associations between different genes in different cellular contexts.

evidence_spans.content: In silico quantitative knockout was performed by decreasing target gene expression value; in silico overexpression by increasing expression to a specific level.

provenance.text_excerpt: The in silico quantitative knockout was performed by decreasing the target gene expression value in the single-cell transcriptome. The in silico overexpression was achieved by increasing the expression of the target gene to a specific level.

experiments_or_tasks: Fine-tuning for cell type annotation, GRN inference, drug dose response prediction, gene expression profiling, gene dosage sensitivity prediction, and gene perturbation prediction.
In silico perturbation experiments for cell fate prediction and key regulatory factor identification.
Pre-training on 101,768,420 single-cell transcriptomes from human and mouse with four types of prior biological knowledge.

methods.name: GeneCompass model architecture
methods.protocol_description: Transformer-based self-attention mechanism; genes ranked and combined with expression values for dual encoding input.

methods.name: In silico perturbation
methods.protocol_description: Quantitative knockout by decreasing target gene expression to half, quarter, or zero; overexpression by increasing expression to a specific level. Cell embeddings obtained from GeneCompass; effect measured by cosine similarity between post-perturbation and ground-truth cell embeddings.

methods.name: Drug dose response prediction (CPA)
methods.protocol_description: Used Compositional Perturbation Autoencoder (CPA) with gene embeddings from pre-trained models (GeneCompass, Geneformer, scGPT) to predict expression changes of specific genes under different drugs and dosages.

methods.name: Gene expression profiling prediction (DeepCE)
methods.protocol_description: DeepCE model with three components: feature transformation (GCN, pre-trained PPI network, feed-forward NN), interaction network (multi-head attention), and prediction network (two-layer feed-forward NN with ReLU). Learning rate 2e-4, batch size 32, epochs 120.

methods.name: Gene dosage sensitivity prediction
methods.protocol_description: Fine-tuned GeneCompass on 10,000 random single-cell transcriptomes to distinguish dosage-sensitive vs. insensitive TFs, following Geneformer protocol.

methods.name: GRN inference (DeepSEM)
methods.protocol_description: Used DeepSEM with ChIP-Seq data from BEELINE framework as ground truth; diagonal fixed to zero; gene relationships from pre-defined models used to update DeepSEM.

study_units.name: GeneCompass pre-training and downstream task evaluation
